title: Mind Reader
tagline: A browser game where you press left or right and a machine tries to guess your next press before you make it — reconstructing two real 1950s Bell Labs machines from their original papers and staging their historical rematch, while measuring exactly how you fail to be random

metrics.label: Predictors running live against you, including two 1950s machines rebuilt from primary sources
Rounds played against a coin in CI — the machine must converge to 50% or the build fails
Input-to-reveal latency, so the machine is never visibly thinking
Runtime dependencies — react and react-dom, nothing else
